verdict.rationale: The pricing page names more than one transcription option: Reverb ASR (via free credits) and Whisper Large at a published $0.005/minute. The async docs give a 12–24 hour turnaround for human transcription, so a developer can see some cost and latency differences between options. Accuracy is described only with a generic marketing claim, not per model. missing for 10: a documented model-selection parameter or model catalog, per-model accuracy figures (e.g., WER), per-model latency figures for ASR options, a full side-by-side cost comparison of models, and independent corroboration.
